'''J-47''' was the designation of the [[Brewery district]]'s residential section in [[Galactic City/Legends|Galactic City]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].
